subject: Annual boiler service
body:
Hi Alex,

The gas engineer needs to do the annual boiler service at the flat this week.
He can come Wednesday or Thursday morning, any time between 9am and 12pm.
Could you let me know which morning suits you?

Thanks,
Martin Hughes
Hughes Lettings

subject: Re: Lunch tomorrow?
body:
Hey! Still on for lunch tomorrow? Something's come up at 12:30 - could we push it
to 1pm instead? Same place, same length.

P

subject: Quick favour - Sam's number?
body:
Hi Alex,

A few of us are planning a surprise for Jordan's leaving drinks on Friday and want to rope partners in.
Could you send me Sam's mobile number? I'll message them directly.

Need it by lunchtime if you can!

Chris
